Welcome to your ultimate getaway pad in East Nashville, just moments from Broadway! Ideal for bachelor and bachelorette bashes, this spacious 3 bedroom Airbnb boasts a huge backyard with a fire table, cornhole, table for beer pong and lawn pong. We live next door so we should be able to help quickly if needed
